title: Fictional sampling result for MOD-100 model governance and registry

assessor.name: Morgan Ellis
assessor.independence_statement: This fictional assessor has no operational ownership of the assessed Summit Analytics CAP-140 capability.

assessment_scope.subject: Fictional Summit Analytics workforce-research assistant CAP-140 model registry entry
assessment_scope.boundary: Model registry completeness and deployment reconciliation for CAP-140 during the engagement period.
exclusions: Model validation depth under MOD-120 and retirement under MOD-150.
assessment_scope.population: Fictional MOD controls assigned to CAP-140.
assessment_scope.sample: MOD-100 only, as selected in the third Draft deepen sampling vignette.

methods.procedure: MOD-100-A1 - Examine completeness and approval of the fictional CAP-140 model registry record.
methods.expected_result: Registry record includes unique identifier, owner, purpose, provider, version, lifecycle state, risk classification, validation status, deployment links, and review date.
methods.actual_work: Examined the fictional registry card for CAP-140 inference alias, including ownership, approval, and deployment links.

methods.procedure: MOD-100-A2 - Reconcile deployed model identifiers with the registry.
methods.object: Fictional production gateway model alias and registry identifier for CAP-140.
methods.expected_result: Deployed model identifier matches the approved registry entry.
methods.actual_work: Compared the fictional gateway-resolved model hash to the registry immutable identifier and found a match.

methods.procedure: MOD-100-A3 - Interview registry ownership and update triggers.
methods.expected_result: Registry ownership and update triggers are confirmed by the accountable owner.
methods.actual_work: Interviewed the fictional model owner about registry ownership and update triggers after a prompt-routing change.

determination_rationale: The fictional registry record was complete and approved, the deployed identifier matched the registry, and the observed update trigger was exercised for CAP-140.
limitations: This fictional Draft deepen result does not assess a real organization.
Reconciliation covered only one fictional model alias for CAP-140.
